description: Run a whole plan on this machine: for every function x shape, generate -> verify -> retry once with the error appended -> escalate. Generation is local and costs zero Claude tokens; only the BatchResult comes back, so you see survivors and escalations rather than raw worker output. Minutes, not seconds — roughly 10 s per TypeScript candidate and 40 s per Swift one.

concurrency.description: candidates in flight; a ceiling, lowered when free RAM says so

dry_run.description: write the tasks and report the concurrency, then stop before the first token

test_target.description: Swift only: the test target under Tests/ (ADR-0014), overriding the plan

name: sidecrew_run_batch
